title: HybriMoE: Hybrid CPU-GPU Scheduling and Cache Management for Efficient MoE Inference
evidence_span: Mixture of Experts models require memory offloading and on-demand loading; HybriMoE combines dynamic intra-layer scheduling, impact-driven prefetching, and score-based caching, reporting 1.33x prefill and 1.70x decode speedups.
problem: MoE expert activation and cache misses make CPU-GPU task-to-hardware mapping and offload management unpredictable under constrained GPU memory.
method_or_artifact: Hybrid CPU-GPU inference system combining dynamic intra-layer scheduling, impact-driven expert prefetching, and score-based expert caching.
workload_or_benchmark: Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct, DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat, and Qwen2-57B-A14B-Instruct; prefill uses MT Bench, Vicuna Bench, and ChatGPT Prompts at approximately 32, 128, 512, and 1024 input tokens; decode uses ChatGPT Prompts.
hardware_or_process_assumptions: NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU and Intel Xeon Gold 5220R CPU with ten CPU cores; kTransformers and llama.cpp kernels; authors describe 4-bit Marlin quantization, but implementation provenance and exact software commits are not independently verified.
limits: Only one identified CPU/GPU setup is assessed; hardware diversity is not demonstrated.
Batch/concurrency settings, repeat counts, variance, accuracy parity, and aggregation weights remain unknown.
Exact software commits and equivalence to the final proceedings version are unverified.
The selected-section extraction is not a complete full-paper adjudication or independent reproduction.
